description.narrative: Degree: bachelor's, master's and doctorate Non degree: Certificate and diploma

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: Short course development in food safety, post-harvest management, IPM, greenhouse management is ongoing. At least 2 courses will be delivered in year 4.
10-03-2022: 1 new BSc program was developed for KyU and 1 Diploma was revised for BAC-based on LMNA results.

10-03-2022: We planned one course program for KyU and BAC. The project was focusing on specialized modules which we have revised but not yet completely developed. KyU and BAC are to develop a module on post-harvest management.

title.narrative: A.E.4. Number of graduates delivered

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: Students will enrol when the program has been accredted by the National Council for Higher Education. KyU expects to enroll 50 students per year for the horticulture program, While BAC continues to run the Diploma programme pending approval by National Curriculum Development Centre.

10-03-2022: Because of COVID, teaching activities were put on hold. Students will enrol when institutions are reopened. Good to mention that a program is 3 years, so during the project period, graduation itself is not an option. KyU expects 50 students for the horticulture program per year, the same for BAC.
10-03-2022: The first year is focusing on LMNA and TNA. Based on this new courses will be developed. So, students will enrol later (320 in year 2).

title.narrative: A.E.6. Number of students enrolled in revised/newly developed study programmes

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: Enrollment could not take place before the programmes are launched. At least 2 courses will be delivered in year 4.

10-03-2022: Because of COVID, teaching activities were put on hold. Students will enrol when institutions are reopened. Good to mention that a program is 3 years, so during the project period, graduation itself is not an option. KyU expects 50 students for the horticulture program per year, the same for BAC.
10-03-2022: The first year is focusing on LMNA and TNA. Based on this, new courses will be developed. So, students will enrol later (150 in year 2, 350 in year 3).

title.narrative: A.O.2. Number of organisations revised/developed and implemented a strategic plan

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: Workplace programme initiated with a visit to Kilimo Kisasa in West Nile however, no stragic plan for the workplace program has been developed this year. Strategic plan food safety with HortiFresh is ongoing.

14-03-2022: 2 gender policies are ongoing and will be finalized in year 2. Mapping financial funds and joint training program was not based on realistic planning, now year 2. Triple Helix plan delayed because of COVID-19. Triple Helix plan is being finalized and will feed into the TVET’s strategic planning.

14-03-2022: Developments in gender are still ongoing. TH launched; 3 working groups formed and activities ongoing. Workplace programme initiated; however, the team has not travelled due to Covid restrictions; now planned for October 2021 (year 3)

title.narrative: A.E.3. Number of staff that have gained qualitative and relevant knowledge and skills to develop and offer the revised/developed study programmes

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: There is a limited number of relevant staff at KyU and BAC. So the same staff participate in the different training activities. 4 more staff added to the previous people.

14-03-2022: 8 male participants and 3 female participants which engaged in 4 different trainings: LMNA, TNA and didactical training and “content” training and exposure visit. Because of the limited number of relevant staff at KyU and BAC, most of the time, these are the same people.

14-03-2022: Blended (online and physical) training in the field of pedagogical and didactical skills, career guidance and technical subjects such as post-harvest management and IPM enhances relevant knowledge and skills.
Long term training as MSc and PhD is not part of this project. Focus is on short training; in the field of pedagocial and didactical skills, career guidance and technical subjects such as post-harvest management and IPM and practical training on greenhouse management and greenhouse construction via AgroMax.

title.narrative: A.R.2. Number of relevant publications (level, gender, inclusion)

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: No scientific research papers yet.
14-03-2022: An assessment report of current horticulture curriculum has been developed as well as a mapping and assessment study of relevant market actors in horticulture in Uganda.
14-03-2022: Newsletter KyU about project and objecties.

title.narrative: A.O.11. Number of organisations with policies and procedures to ensure an environment which is gender sensitive

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: Both KYU and BAC have a Gender Policy
14-03-2022: BAC has been working on a Gender Equality policy and Gender Action Plan, to be finished before December 2020
14-03-2022: Gender mainstreaming activities are ongoing

title.narrative: A.O.6. Number of facilities established/strengthened

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: 2 units of greenhouse, hydroponics system, open filed irrigation infrastructure completed at KyU Renovation of backup water supply system at BAC to be completed soon.
14-03-2022: Conform planning started in year 1 and will be implemented in year 2, so in line with planning, but on-going.
14-03-2022: New full greenhouse + irrigation infrastructure at KyU Renovation of irrigation, water supply and pump system at BAC

title.narrative: A.S.1. Number of beneficiaries in the society reached with knowledge, skills and techniques

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: A 3-day exhibition was held at the Kyambogo Univeristy titled “STEAM Festival” (Science, Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Mathematics) June 15th -17th 2022. It was attended by over 1.500 participants where horticulture products were displayed.
14-03-2022: Dissemination of new knowledge and skills will be included in the online teaching program that is being developed.

14-03-2022: New knowledge and skills will be developed for dissemination (online) after the training programmes are running. The improved training infrastructure with greenhouses and irrigation systems will add a lot of value to this objective.

title.narrative: A.S.4. Number of SMEs supported

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: SMEs were involved in several activities curriculum scoping and development, Triple Helix, and workplace programme.

14-03-2022: Due to COVID-19 implications and change in KyU management, 20 stakeholders were engaged in the LMNA and around 25 in the Triple Helix. The engagement led to shared insights into the challenges faced by the sector and what can be done about it and set the stage for the 3H platform.
14-03-2022: SMEs involved in curriculum scoping and development, TH and workplace programme. Conclusive collaborations will be made in year 3

title.narrative: A.S.2. Number of MoUs or other types of collaboration agreements signed (education, private, public, surrounding community)

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: 5 MoUs from the workplace and TH partners are yet to be signed. We expect that additional MoU’s will be signed in the last implementation year.
14-03-2022: For LMNA and Triple Helix activities, mapping was executed. We expect that as follow-up of LMNA and Triple Helix, first MOU’s will be signed in year 2.
14-03-2022: We envisage a collaborative agreement from the workplace and TH partners in year 3.

title.narrative: A.R.3. Number of relevant innovations

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: In the new greenhouse of KyU, an modern hydroponic system and Irrigation systems are implemented.
14-03-2022: In year 1, no relevant innovations
14-03-2022: Via Triple Helix assessment, several innovations are identified. Follow up via TH working groups to implement in the 3rd year

title.narrative: A.S.3. Number of students performing an internship or practical work

comment.narrative: 08-11-2022: Internship placement to be developed during the implementation of the Bachelor programme, however BAC and KyU still want to send up 50 Diploma students for internship per academic year. We expect 100 students before the end of the project end.
14-03-2022: Because of COVID, Training activities were put on hold
14-03-2022: Workplace and internship program are planned in year 2.
